rules: Headings must use Manrope. Do not use Inter for headings.
Use tight tracking for all headings larger than 24px.
Use tabular nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for all data/scores.

usage.background: Deep matte charcoal/zinc (not pure black) to reduce eye strain.
usage.accent: Electric Blue for 'Select/Keep' actions. Use sparingly.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on the main background to mimic film stock.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-4

cards.image_card: relative group overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-card hover:border-accent/50 transition-colors
cards.stat_card: p-6 rounded-xl bg-card border border-border flex flex-col gap-2

inputs.default: bg-input/50 border-transparent focus:border-accent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent rounded-md h-12 px-4

images.description: Close up of camera lens for hero section background or side visual.
Abstract light leak for subtle background texture or accent areas.
Minimalist workspace for 'How it works' or 'About' section.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use thin stroke width (1.5px) for elegance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Dark Mode First' approach. The default theme should be dark/neutral.
Use the 'Manrope' font for all headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
The Upload Area should be a massive, cinematic drop zone using the 'texture_overlay' image with low opacity.
The Gallery View must be dense but breathable. Use a masonry layout if possible, or a strict grid with 'object-cover'.
Use 'sonner' for all notifications (upload complete, analysis done).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or the provided texture images.
For the 'Good/Bad' filter, use a toggle group or segmented control, not a dropdown.
Display AI scores (Sharpness, Exposure) as small, minimal badges on the image card.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' gradients. Stick to the defined palette.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual. Let the photos breathe.
Micro-interactions are mandatory. Hovering an image should reveal details smoothly.
Ensure high contrast for text overlaying images (use text-shadow or scrims).
